search.title: Search the official materials
search.subtitle: Searches only checked questions and confirmed rules of the active catalogues. Every result names its source and page.
search.method: Ask a question or type a term in Bosnian, German or English. Gemini translates the query into all three languages, finds passages of the official materials by meaning and by words, and answers only from them, citing the source. Without a key or semantic index the search works by words.
search.queryHint: For example: how long is the exam, calculator, Perfekt, Hasanaginica.
search.subject: Subject
search.refusal: The official materials contain no answer to this question.
search.empty: The index has no text yet. The Superadministrator builds it with "Build index".

index.title: Search index
index.intro: The index holds checked questions and confirmed rules of the active catalogues. Build it again after new review decisions; existing text stays.

exam.title: Mock exam
exam.subtitle: As in the external graduate examination
exam.intro: A mock exam has the same number of tasks, points and duration as the external graduate examination. The app composes the set by the official catalogue, and a teacher checks and approves it before you start. The grade comes from the teacher.

blueprints.title: Exam blueprints
blueprints.hint: The blueprint sets which catalogue tasks the app may put at which position and how many points they carry. It is derived from the official tests and the catalogue. The subject teacher confirms that the blueprint matches these documents; only then can students request a mock exam.
blueprints.confirmQuestion: Do you confirm that the blueprint matches the official tests and the catalogue? Students can then request mock exams.
blueprints.noConfig: There is no blueprint for this subject in the repository.

exam.approvalHint: Check every task and the official key. The set is composed by the confirmed blueprint; approve it or discard it with a reason.
exam.gradingHint: Every answer is shown beside the official key of the catalogue. Choice and true or false tasks are pre-scored by the printed key; the proposal counts until you change it.
exam.confirmApprove: Approve the set? The student can then start it.
exam.newSet: Compose a new set for the same student at once
exam.confirmHint: When every task is graded, confirm the result. The student then sees points, keys and your notes; the result no longer changes.
exam.confirmResult: Confirm the result? Points cannot be changed afterwards.
